name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 24 Nov; US forecasts see Thanksgiving snow risk
state: US forecasts pointed to possible snow around Thanksgiving on 26 Nov in the interior Northeast and Intermountain West, with heavy rain in the South and on the West Coast on 24 and 25 Nov; these were outlooks, not warnings (Gizmodo, 19 Nov). Searches on 24 Nov found no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region and no cold-related power or gas outages, so Normal holds.
for_you: No major cold wave is under way. US Thanksgiving travel may be disrupted by snow in the north and rain elsewhere; check National Weather Service forecasts. In the UK, follow Met Office warnings.
rubric_hit: Normal: no top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region found on 24 Nov

sources.title: Gizmodo — Forecasts increasingly call for a snowy Thanksgiving despite El Niño

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
